கவன்டம் இயற்பியல் என்பது ஒரு அணுக்கருவியின் அளவில் அமைந்துள்ள தனித்துவமான பண்புகளைப் பற்றி ஆராயும் இயற்பியல் து

Quantum physics is a branch of physics that studies the behavior of matter and energy at an atomic and subatomic level. It's a world where particles can be in two places at once, where time and space are relative, and where the act of observing something can change its behavior. It's a weird and fascinating world that's governed by its own set of rules, and it's the foundation of many modern technologies, from transistors to lasers to computer chips.
